en: Sepia photograph of a formal city park or promenade. A wide path lined with large trees runs from the foreground into the distance, with people strolling and sitting on benches in early 20th‑century clothing. On the right is an ornamental flowerbed with exotic plants, and a man in dark clothes stands beside it holding a hat or walking stick. At the bottom of the image there is a handwritten caption in a cursive Cyrillic script.
